name: Find child care with 4C for Children
description: Staff help you find child care that fits your schedule and budget, or you can search online.
hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.
eligibility: Families in 15 southwest Ohio and Miami Valley counties, including Montgomery and Greene.

steps: Or use the Request Help Finding Child Care form, or the online search.
Ask your county help office if the state can pay for some of your child care.
